primitives.name: Signal Gating Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Welcome Sequence — Galaxy Sports Edge A 5-email founder-voice nurture flow triggered by new free-account signup during the silent-collection phase (before `PUBLIC_PICKS_ENABLED=true`).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time in days since signup', 'H(t)': 'settled history accumulated up to time t', 'R(t)': 'readiness score at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: Public picks are gated until R(t) > threshold T, where T is determined by historical calibration stability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When H(t) fails to converge to stable posterior distribution, R(t) remains below T.

layer2.mapping: The gating mechanism is derived from a Bayesian posterior update kernel that requires minimum evidence for signal publication.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative settled outcomes and readiness score convergence rate.

primitives.name: Calibration Readiness Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: I gate every public surface — picks, performance, the Vault — until the system has enough settled history to publish a calibrated, defensible number.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C(t)': 'calibration confidence at time t', 'S(t)': 'signal strength at time t', 'T': 'threshold for readiness'}
primitives.assumptions: Readiness is defined as C(t) ≥ T, where T ensures statistical robustness of S(t).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when C(t) < T due to insufficient or biased historical data.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a Bayesian credible interval estimator, where readiness is equivalent to posterior coverage probability exceeding a fixed bound.
layer2.telemetry: Posterior variance of signal strength and coverage probability of calibrated intervals.

primitives.name: Epistemic Nurture Flow
primitives.verbatim_quote: Until then, here's the inside view.** Over the next two weeks I'll send four short emails walking you through the methodology — how a signal actually gets scored, gated, and published.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_i': 'email i in nurture sequence', 'M_i': 'methodology content in E_i', 'D(t)': 'depth of epistemic understanding at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: Each E_i contributes incrementally to D(t), with M_i structured to reduce uncertainty about signal process.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D(t) plateaus or decreases, indicating misunderstanding or misinformation propagation.

layer2.mapping: The flow is a derived kernel of information entropy reduction applied iteratively across communication epochs.
layer2.telemetry: Entropy reduction in user comprehension metrics post-email delivery.

Failure modes include premature release due to insufficient data or overfitting to early results.
